choices.label_source: join_eval141.npz built by tanitad/data/v8f_mini_data.py:build_label_join (lines 165-240); the eval harness loads it at stack/scripts/v8f_t1_eval.py:515 (D.load_join) and the trainer packs one row into the tactical targets at v8f_mini_data.py:_lab_pack (lines 607-615).
choices.frame_to_window_rule: Labels are PER FRAME, no window anchor needed: join row off[c] + j is cache step j of clip c (v8f_mini_data.py:162-163), the same step index t that prh_seed.extract stores (asserted n[c] == frames of clip c, clip order identical). Frames used = ok(v2) AND has AND lat_allowed / lon_allowed single-bit; every representation (TR, RI, TAC, SLOW, PCA) is restricted to those frames for every S, fit half and score half alike.
choices.goal_bits: goal_y bit b of the uint32 for b in 0..21, imputed 0.5 where goal_w bit is 0 (the trainer's own target rule, v8f_mini.py:_code_gt line 895-896).
choices.lat_lon: one-hot of lat_cls (5) and lon_cls (7); single-class = popcount(lat_allowed) == 1 and popcount(lon_allowed) == 1 (cls equals that bit, checked).
choices.degenerate: a target column is dropped if its standard deviation is < 1e-9 on the fit half OR on the score half of the TAC frames.
choices.TAC_rank: the 31 non-constant outputs are linearly dependent (lat one-hot of 3 present classes and lon one-hot sum to 1, plus goal-bit dependencies): TAC is rotated onto the eigen-directions of its fit-half covariance with eigenvalue > 1e-8 x max (rank_reduce), d_TAC = that rank. Added AFTER a first run at d=31 failed C-SELF (S 0.834, see README); the first run's numbers are kept there.
choices.TAC_ridge: W = (C + lam I)^-1 Cov(nm, Y) with C = covariance of nm on the fit-half TAC frames, lam = 1e-3 x mean eigenvalue of C; centred by fit-half means; TAC = (nm - mu_fit) @ W for every frame.
choices.metric: CC32 of prh_seed_v2.metric: mean of the first min(32, d_TAC) canonical correlations (fit half directions, score half correlations; ridge 1e-6), B 2000 clip bootstrap, counts rng seed 0 over the 70 score clips.
choices.SLOW_PCA: built exactly as prh_seed_v2.step_b (SLOW from (t, t+5) pairs over ALL ok fit-half frames, PCA of nm over the same ok fit-half frames) and then evaluated on the TAC frames only.
choices.C-SHUF: prh_seed_v2.permuted (rng seed 5) applied to TAC: frames permuted within the fit half and within the score half (clip membership broken); pass if S(TR0, TAC_shuf) and S(TR1, TAC_shuf) < the v2 FLOOR (CALIB_PRH_SEED_V2.json CC32 FLOOR point).
choices.C-LABEL-SHUF: targets re-assigned across FIT-HALF CLIPS: the fit clips' target blocks are cyclically re-dealt by a random permutation of the clips (rng seed 11; a block is tiled/truncated to the receiving clip's frame count), TAC refit on the scrambled targets, same ridge rule. Pass = Q1 NOT separated-positive at both seeds (the card's Q1 condition); the two-sided flag is also reported. Four more shuffle seeds (12-15) are reported as points only.
choices.R2_recovery: ridge readout of the real targets (fit half -> score half; lam = 1e-3 x mean eigenvalue of the source's own fit-half covariance, centred by fit means) from nm, TR, RI; R2 = mean over target columns of 1 - SSE/SST on the score half (SST about the fit-half mean); fraction = R2(source) / R2(nm). Bootstrap over score clips, same counts.
choices.outcome_rule: controls first: any control fails -> UNUSABLE (not interpreted). Else TAC-LEAN iff Q1 separated positive at both seeds, else NO-TAC-LEAN.
